# 摩利支天一印法

**ID:** T1259
**Volume:** T21
**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 密教部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1259

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A very short anonymous Esoteric ritual text on **Mārīcī**, isolating a single core mudrā (一印 *yīyìn*) and its associated mantra. Catalog meta and canwww (T21N1259) record no translator and no dynasty. The text is the most compressed practical instruction in the Mārīcī cluster ([KR6j0483](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0483)–[KR6j0489](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0489)).

**Abstract**

The text gives the *yīyìn* (single fundamental mudrā) of the Mārīcī rite with its associated mantra and abbreviated visualisation. The format reflects an Indian *kalpa* convention by which a deity's full ritual programme can be reduced to a single core mudrā for daily or emergency use; this is the smallest unit of Mārīcī practice. The dating bracket is conservative.
